main_measure.name: mean unusual 7-day move per case (return minus coin's normal 7-day drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 days with cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, forecast at/above median minus below median

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2 (neither the confirm nor the reject rule is met).
reading: A case is the first bar of each 7-bar grid cell (positions 0, 7, 14, ... of each window) on which the long forecast rises at least 2 points from its lowest level since the last such rise (from 0 after flat), with its 7-bar return inside the window; the t clusters deviations by UTC day with a D/(D-1) correction; the situation is the recorded vsr value (recomputed from prices if missing) at least 2.0 with forecast > 0.
